Furthermore, the case of XXXX XXXX XXXX XXXX XXXX illustrates the consequences of failing to uphold these standards, highlighting the judicial recognition of consumers ' rights to accurate credit reporting. I am writing to formally request validation of the debt referenced above. As the account in question is being reported as a collection account on my credit report, I am exercising my rights under the Fair Debt Collection Practices Act ( FDCPA ) to request verification of this debt. 

Please provide me with the following information : 1. The original creditors name and address. 
2. A complete account history, including any charges, payments, or fees that have been added to the account. 
3. Proof that you are legally entitled to collect on this debt, including a copy of the assignment contract or any agreement transferring the debt to your agency. 
4. A copy of the original signed contract or agreement that created this debt. 
5. Verification of the amount claimed, including any interest, fees, or other charges that have been added to the balance.
